verdict.rationale: Superpowers lets users author their own skills, and its skills auto-trigger when the agent's context matches, such as a bug-fix request routing to systematic-debugging. It also ships built-in triggered safeguards, such as an architectural review after three failed fixes. However, the triggers are model-judged contextual matches, not deterministic event rules, and session-start injection relies on the host harness's hook. Missing for 10: explicit user-defined event→action rule syntax, triggers on non-conversational system events (file changes, CI, schedules), deterministic firing guarantees, independent corroboration that custom triggers work reliably.
